description.value: Hotel Lucerne is a boutique hotel at 201 WEST 79TH STREET, NEW YORK, NY 10024 on the Upper West Side. The hotel invites guests to Dine At Nice Matin, its French bistro. It is a short walk to the American Museum of Natural History and Central Park.
